title: Salesforce true/false question pair
description: One file per pair in questions/<product_area>/<id>.yaml. scripts/validate.py enforces this schema plus content checks (negation-only pairs, duplicates, exam-style wording, source drift).

id.description: Stable and never reused, even after retirement.

product_area.description: Same as the source article's domain and the folder name.

false_statement.description: A plausible twin: changes a limit, default, edition, permission or feature, not just adds 'not'.

explanation.description: Why the true statement is true and the false one is false.

commit.description: Source repo HEAD when the pair was written or last verified.

blob.description: Git blob of the article at that point; a different blob means the article changed (drift).

verified_release.description: Last Salesforce release this pair was checked against.

feature_status.description: Lifecycle of the feature, copied from the source article (current = GA).

certs.description: Certifications from the article's coveredBy edges.

supersedes.description: The retired pair this one replaced when a fact changed.
